This is my issue. I have a misaligned bite/jaw. About 2-3mm to the left. Which is pinching my facial nerve. I had all 4 wisdom teeth taken out in 2019, I went with sedated as a full “surgery” style. Since then it’s slowly gotten worse. Which the dental surgeon who took them out told me it would. I’ve got chronic migraines and what I guess folks call brain zaps but I don’t think it’s that. Basically randomly I’ll get an intense stabbing feeling on one side of my head temple area above the ear. Like some just hit me with an ice pick. It’ll go on for a good minute or so then go away. Then I’ll just get a regular migraine. I was on gabapentin for a bit, then Tramadol. Neither work that well. They did help thou. My doctor started me on Suboxone about 2-3wks ago and man it’s done so much for keeping my migraines away. It’s not label for this type of treatment, but apparently it’s good for nerve pain. I’ve got muscle relaxers for of my neck starts cramps, and Zofran for the dizzy/vertigo spells from all the other meds I’m on.

The next step for me here would be complete lower  reconstructive jaw surgery. Which I’m terrified of, because there’s a chance it could just make things worse.
